channel: Don't Waste Your Time, This Video May Not B4U!
description:
I have owned many cars in my life - way before most of you were born. I don't consider myself a gear head, but in my younger days, I would put an aftermarket (otherwise known as "mods") or two to impress my friends, but mostly for the ladies. As time passed, I graduated from college, got married, had children, retired from the military and gotten older.    
 
So here I am, mid life crisis, I bought a Tesla in 2015. I keep it garaged, spotless and rarely drive it in bad weather. 

Here you’ll find:
• Electric vehicle reviews and ownership experiences
• Tesla modifications and accessories
• Home battery backup and energy solutions
• Charging technology and EV equipment
• Interviews with EV owners and industry experts
• Tips, tutorials, and real-world experiences

Don't complain to me; I told you "Don't waste your time, this video may not be for you". However,  I have met some really cool EV owners and decided to find out their stories.
